import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3
from src.repository import initialize
from src.service import get_document, list_documents
c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
initialize(c)
c.execute("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (1, 't', 'o', 'Title', 'Body', NULL)")
c.commit()
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 1) == {"id": 1, "title": "Title", "body": "Body"}
assert list_documents(c, "t", "o") == [{"id": 1, "title": "Title", "body": "Body"}]
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 99) is None

# Isolation, deletion, ordering and quoting
c.executemany("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)", [
    (2, "t", "o", "Second", "B2", None),
    (3, "t2", "o", "OtherTenant", "x", None),
    (4, "t", "o2", "OtherOwner", "x", None),
    (5, "t", "o", "Deleted", "x", "2026-01-01"),
    (0, "t", "o", "Zero", "B0", None),
    (6, "t'; DROP TABLE documents;--", "o'x", "Q", "BQ", None),
])
c.commit()
for bad in (3, 4, 5, 99):
    assert get_document(c, "t", "o", bad) is None
assert [d["id"] for d in list_documents(c, "t", "o")] == [0, 1, 2]
assert all(set(d) == {"id", "title", "body"} for d in list_documents(c, "t", "o"))
assert get_document(c, "t'; DROP TABLE documents;--", "o'x", 6) == {"id": 6, "title": "Q", "body": "BQ"}
assert get_document(c, "t", "o'x", 6) is None
assert list_documents(c, "t' OR '1'='1", "o") == []
assert list_documents(c, "nobody", "o") == []
